verses.text: When all di kings wey dey di other side of Jordan, for di hill country, and for di lowland, and for all di coast of di great sea toward Lebanon, di Hittites, di Amorites, di Canaanites, di Perizzites, di Hivites, and di Jebusites, hear am,
dem gather together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one mind.
But di people wey dey live for Gibeon hear wetin Joshua don do to Jericho and to Ai,
and dem use cunning, dem go, dey act like ambassadors, and take old sacks put on dem donkeys, and old wine skins, wey don tear and dem tie up,
with old shoes wey dem patch for dem feet, and old garments on dem. All di bread of dem food dey dry and don turn mouldy.
Dem go meet Joshua for di camp for Gilgal, and talk to am and to di men of Israel say, “We come from one far country. So now, make covenant with us.”
Di men of Israel talk to di Hivites say, “Maybe una dey live among us. How we go take make covenant with una?”
Dem talk to Joshua say, “We na your servants.” Joshua talk to dem say, “Who una be? Wia una come from?”
Dem talk to am say, “Your servants come from one very far country because of di name of di Lord your God, because we don hear im fame, and all wey e do for Egypt,
and all wey e do to di two kings of di Amorites, wey dey di other side of Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, wey dey for Ashtaroth.

Our elders and all di people wey dey live for our country speak to us, talk say, ‘Take food for una hand for di journey, and go meet dem, and tell dem, “We na una servants. Now make covenant with us.”’
Dis our bread, we take am hot from our houses as food for di day wey we leave to come meet una, but now, look, e don dry and don turn mouldy.
Dis wine skins wey we fill, dem dey new, and look, dem don tear. Dis our garments and our shoes don old because of di very long journey.”
Di men take some of dem food, and dem no ask counsel from di mouth of di Lord.
Joshua make peace with dem, and make covenant with dem, to let dem live, and di princes of di congregation swear to dem.
E happen say at di end of three days after dem don make covenant with dem, dem hear say dem na dem neighbours, and say dem dey live among dem.
Di pikin dem of Israel travel, and reach dem cities for di third day. Now dem cities na Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.
Di pikin dem of Israel no strike dem, because di princes of di congregation don swear to dem by di Lord, di God of Israel. All di congregation complain against di princes.
But all di princes talk to all di congregation say, “We don swear to dem by di Lord, di God of Israel. So now we no fit touch dem.
Dis na wetin we go do to dem: we go let dem live, so that wrath no go dey on us because of di oath wey we swear to dem.”
Di princes talk to dem say, “Make dem live.” So dem become wood cutters and water carriers for all di congregation, as di princes speak to dem.
Joshua call dem, and speak to dem, talk say, “Why una deceive us, say, ‘We dey very far from una,’ when una dey live among us?
Now una dey under curse, and servants from among una no go ever finish, both wood cutters and water carriers for di house of my God.”

Dem answer Joshua, talk say, “Because dem tell your servants clearly how di Lord your God command im servant Moses to give una all di land, and to destroy all di people wey dey live for di land from before una. So we fear plenty for our lives because of una, and we do dis thing.
Now, look, we dey for your hand. Wetin good and right for your eyes to do to us, do am.”
So e do am to dem, and deliver dem from di hand of di pikin dem of Israel, so dem no kill dem.
For dat day Joshua make dem wood cutters and water carriers, for di congregation, and for di altar of di Lord, till today, for di place wey e go choose.

E happen say, when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem hear how Joshua take Ai, and utterly destroy am, as e do to Jericho and im king, so e do to Ai and im king, and how di people wey dey live for Gibeon don make peace with Israel, and dey among dem,
dem fear plenty, because Gibeon na big city, like one of di royal cities, and because e big pass Ai, and all im men dey mighty.
So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem send message to Hoham king of Hebron, and to Piram king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, talk,
“Come up to me, and help me, make we strike Gibeon, because e don make peace with Joshua and with di pikin dem of Israel.”

So di five kings of di Amorites, di king of Jerusalem, di king of Hebron, di king of Jarmuth, di king of Lachish, di king of Eglon, gather together, and go up, dem and all dem armies, and camp against Gibeon, and fight against am.

Di men of Gibeon send message to Joshua for di camp for Gilgal, talk say, “No leave your servants. Come up to us quick, and save us, and help us, because all di kings of di Amorites wey dey live for di hill country don gather together against us.”
So Joshua go up from Gilgal, e, and all di people of war wey dey with am, and all di mighty men of valour.
Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “No fear dem, because I don deliver dem into your hands. Nobody among dem go fit stand before you.”
So Joshua come to dem suddenly, because e go up from Gilgal all night.
Di Lord confuse dem before Israel, and e kill dem with big slaughter for Gibeon, and chase dem follow di way wey dey go up to Beth Horon, and strike dem reach Azekah, and Makkedah.

E happen say, as dem dey run from before Israel, while dem dey for di slope of Beth Horon, di Lord throw big stones from di sky fall on dem reach Azekah, and dem die. Di people wey die by di hailstones plenty pass di people wey di pikin dem of Israel kill with di sword.

Den Joshua speak to di Lord for di day wey di Lord deliver di Amorites before di pikin dem of Israel, and e talk for di eyes of Israel say, “Sun, stand still over Gibeon. Moon, for di valley of Aijalon.”

Di sun stand still, and di moon stop, until di nation take revenge on dem enemies. Dem no write am for di book of Jashar? Di sun stop for di middle of di sky, and e no hurry go down for about one whole day.
No day like dat dey before am or after am, wey di Lord listen to di voice of one man, because di Lord fight for Israel.
Joshua return, and all Israel with am, to di camp for Gilgal.
Dis five kings run, and hide for di cave for Makkedah.
Dem tell Joshua say, “Dem don find di five kings, dem hide for di cave for Makkedah.”
Joshua talk say, “Roll big stones put for di mouth of di cave, and set men dere to guard dem.
But una no stay dere. Chase una enemies, and attack dem from behind. No allow dem enter dem cities, because di Lord una God don deliver dem into una hand.”
E happen say, when Joshua and di pikin dem of Israel finish to kill dem with very big slaughter, until dem finish, and di remnant wey remain of dem don enter di fortified cities,
all di people return to di camp to Joshua for Makkedah in peace. Nobody move im tongue against any of di pikin dem of Israel.
Den Joshua talk say, “Open di mouth of di cave, and bring out dem five kings come to me from di cave.”
Dem do so, and bring out dem five kings come to am from di cave, di king of Jerusalem, di king of Hebron, di king of Jarmuth, di king of Lachish, and di king of Eglon.

E happen say, when dem bring out dem kings to Joshua, Joshua call all di men of Israel, and talk to di chiefs of di men of war wey follow am go say, “Come near. Put una feet on di necks of dis kings.” Dem come near, and put dem feet on dem necks.
Joshua talk to dem say, “No fear, and no shake. Be strong and get courage, because di Lord go do dis to all una enemies wey una dey fight against.”
After dat Joshua strike dem, and put dem to death, and hang dem on five trees, and dem dey hang on di trees until evening.

E happen say as di sun dey go down, Joshua command, and dem bring dem down from di trees, and throw dem inside di cave wia dem hide, and put big stones for di mouth of di cave, wey dey dere till today.

Joshua take Makkedah for dat day, and strike am with di edge of di sword, and im king. E utterly destroy dem and all di souls wey dey inside am. E no leave anybody remain. E do to di king of Makkedah as e do to di king of Jericho.
Joshua pass from Makkedah, and all Israel with am, go Libnah, and fight against Libnah.

Di Lord deliver am too, and im king, into di hand of Israel, and e strike am with di edge of di sword, and all di souls wey dey inside am. E no leave anybody remain inside am. E do to im king as e do to di king of Jericho.
Joshua pass from Libnah, and all Israel with am, go Lachish, and camp against am, and fight against am.
Di Lord deliver Lachish into di hand of Israel, and e take am for di second day, and strike am with di edge of di sword, and all di souls wey dey inside am, according to all wey e do to Libnah.
Den Horam king of Gezer come up to help Lachish, and Joshua strike am and im people, until e no leave anybody remain for am.
Joshua pass from Lachish, and all Israel with am, go Eglon, and dem camp against am, and fight against am,
and dem take am for dat day, and strike am with di edge of di sword. All di souls wey dey inside am, e utterly destroy dem dat day, according to all wey e do to Lachish.
Joshua go up from Eglon, and all Israel with am, go Hebron, and dem fight against am,

and dem take am, and strike am with di edge of di sword, and im king, and all im cities, and all di souls wey dey inside am. E no leave anybody remain, according to all wey e do to Eglon, and e utterly destroy am, and all di souls wey dey inside am.
Joshua return, and all Israel with am, go Debir, and fight against am,

and e take am, and im king, and all im cities, and dem strike dem with di edge of di sword, and utterly destroy all di souls wey dey inside am. E no leave anybody remain. As e do to Hebron, so e do to Debir, and to im king, as e do also to Libnah, and to im king.

So Joshua strike all di land, di hill country, and di South, and di lowland, and di slopes, and all dem kings. E no leave anybody remain, but e utterly destroy all wey dey breathe, as di Lord, di God of Israel, command.
Joshua strike dem from Kadesh Barnea reach Gaza, and all di country of Goshen, reach Gibeon.
Joshua take all dis kings and dem land for one time, because di Lord, di God of Israel, fight for Israel.
Joshua return, and all Israel with am, to di camp for Gilgal.
E happen say, when Jabin king of Hazor hear am, e send message to Jobab king of Madon, and to di king of Shimron, and to di king of Achshaph,
and to di kings wey dey for di north, for di hill country, and for di Arabah south of Chinneroth, and for di lowland, and for di heights of Dor for di west,
to di Canaanites for di east and for di west, and di Amorites, and di Hittites, and di Perizzites, and di Jebusites for di hill country, and di Hivites under Hermon for di land of Mizpah.
Dem go out, dem and all dem armies with dem, plenty people, as plenty as di sand wey dey di seashore, with very plenty horses and chariots.
All dis kings meet together, and dem come camp together for di waters of Merom, to fight with Israel.

Di Lord talk to Joshua say, “No fear because of dem, because tomorrow by dis time I go deliver dem all up, dead, before Israel. You must cut di back leg tendons of dem horses, and burn dem chariots with fire.”
So Joshua come, and all di people of war wey dey with am, against dem by di waters of Merom suddenly, and attack dem.

Di Lord deliver dem into di hand of Israel, and dem strike dem, and chase dem reach great Sidon, and Misrephoth Maim, and di valley of Mizpeh for di east, and dem strike dem until dem no leave anybody remain.
Joshua do to dem as di Lord tell am. E cut di back leg tendons of dem horses, and burn dem chariots with fire.
Joshua turn back for dat time, and take Hazor, and strike im king with di sword, because Hazor before na di head of all dem kingdoms.
Dem strike all di souls wey dey inside am with di edge of di sword, dey utterly destroy dem. Nobody wey dey breathe remain. E burn Hazor with fire.
Joshua take all di cities of dem kings, and all dem kings, and strike dem with di edge of di sword, and e utterly destroy dem, as Moses di servant of di Lord command.
But as for di cities wey stand on dem mounds, Israel no burn any of dem, except Hazor only. Dat one Joshua burn.

All di plunder of dis cities, and di livestock, di pikin dem of Israel take for dem own self, but every man dem strike with di edge of di sword, until dem destroy dem, and dem no leave anybody wey dey breathe.
As di Lord command Moses im servant, so Moses command Joshua, and so Joshua do. E no leave anything undone of all wey di Lord command Moses.
So Joshua take all dat land, di hill country, and all di South, and all di land of Goshen, and di lowland, and di Arabah, and di hill country of Israel, and di lowland of di same,
from Mount Halak, wey go up to Seir, reach Baal Gad for di valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon. E take all dem kings, and strike dem, and put dem to death.
Joshua fight war for long time with all dem kings.
No city make peace with di pikin dem of Israel, except di Hivites wey dey live for Gibeon. Dem take all by battle.
Because na di Lord make dem heart hard, to come against Israel for battle, so that e go utterly destroy dem, so that dem no go get favour, but so that e go destroy dem, as di Lord command Moses.

Joshua come for dat time, and cut off di Anakim from di hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all di hill country of Judah, and from all di hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroy dem with dem cities.
Nobody among di Anakim remain for di land of di pikin dem of Israel. Only for Gaza, for Gath, and for Ashdod, some remain.
So Joshua take di whole land, according to all wey di Lord speak to Moses, and Joshua give am as inheritance to Israel according to dem divisions by dem tribes. Di land get rest from war.

Now dis na di kings of di land wey di pikin dem of Israel strike, and possess dem land for di other side of Jordan toward where di sun dey rise, from di valley of Arnon reach Mount Hermon, and all di Arabah for di east:

Sihon king of di Amorites, wey dey live for Heshbon, and rule from Aroer, wey dey for di edge of di valley of Arnon, and from di middle of di valley, and half of Gilead, reach di river Jabbok, di border of di pikin dem of Ammon,
and di Arabah reach di sea of Chinneroth for di east, and reach di sea of di Arabah, even di Salt Sea, for di east, di way to Beth Jeshimoth, and for di south, under di slopes of Pisgah.
And di border of Og king of Bashan, one of di remnant of di Rephaim, wey dey live for Ashtaroth and for Edrei,
and rule for Mount Hermon, and for Salecah, and for all Bashan, reach di border of di Geshurites and di Maacathites, and half of Gilead, reach di border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
Moses di servant of di Lord and di pikin dem of Israel strike dem, and Moses di servant of di Lord give am as possession to di Reubenites, and di Gadites, and di half-tribe of Manasseh.

Dis na di kings of di land wey Joshua and di pikin dem of Israel strike for di other side of Jordan toward di west, from Baal Gad for di valley of Lebanon reach Mount Halak, wey go up to Seir, and Joshua give am to di tribes of Israel as possession according to dem divisions,

for di hill country, and for di lowland, and for di Arabah, and for di slopes, and for di wilderness, and for di South: di Hittites, di Amorites, and di Canaanites, di Perizzites, di Hivites, and di Jebusites.
Di king of Jericho, one. Di king of Ai, wey dey beside Bethel, one.
Di king of Jerusalem, one. Di king of Hebron, one.
Di king of Jarmuth, one. Di king of Lachish, one.
Di king of Eglon, one. Di king of Gezer, one.
Di king of Debir, one. Di king of Geder, one.
Di king of Hormah, one. Di king of Arad, one.
Di king of Libnah, one. Di king of Adullam, one.
Di king of Makkedah, one. Di king of Bethel, one.
Di king of Tappuah, one. Di king of Hepher, one.
Di king of Aphek, one. Di king of Lasharon, one.
Di king of Madon, one. Di king of Hazor, one.
Di king of Shimron Meron, one. Di king of Achshaph, one.
Di king of Taanach, one. Di king of Megiddo, one.
Di king of Kedesh, one. Di king of Jokneam for Carmel, one.
Di king of Dor for di height of Dor, one. Di king of Goiim for Gilgal, one.
Di king of Tirzah, one. All di kings na 31.
Now Joshua don old and don reach plenty years, and di Lord talk to am say, “You don old and don reach plenty years, and plenty land still dey wey dem never possess.
Dis na di land wey still remain: all di regions of di Philistines, and all di Geshurites,

from di Shihor, wey dey before Egypt, reach di border of Ekron for di north, wey dem count as for di Canaanites. Di five lords of di Philistines: di Gazites, di Ashdodites, di Ashkelonites, di Gittites, and di Ekronites, and di Avvim too,
for di south. All di land of di Canaanites, and Mearah wey belong to di Sidonians, reach Aphek, reach di border of di Amorites,
and di land of di Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward where di sun dey rise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon reach di entrance of Hamath,

all di people wey dey live for di hill country from Lebanon reach Misrephoth Maim, even all di Sidonians. I go drive dem out from before di pikin dem of Israel. Only share am to Israel as inheritance, as I command you.
Now divide dis land as inheritance to di nine tribes, and di half-tribe of Manasseh.”
With am, di Reubenites and di Gadites receive dem inheritance, wey Moses give dem, for di other side of Jordan for di east, as Moses di servant of di Lord give dem,
from Aroer, wey dey for di edge of di valley of Arnon, and di city wey dey for di middle of di valley, and all di plain of Medeba reach Dibon,
and all di cities of Sihon king of di Amorites, wey rule for Heshbon, reach di border of di pikin dem of Ammon,
and Gilead, and di border of di Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan reach Salecah,
all di kingdom of Og for Bashan, wey rule for Ashtaroth and for Edrei. Na im remain of di remnant of di Rephaim. Moses strike dem, and drive dem out.
But di pikin dem of Israel no drive out di Geshurites, or di Maacathites. Geshur and Maacath dey live among Israel till today.
Only to di tribe of Levi e no give inheritance. Di offerings of di Lord, di God of Israel, wey dem make by fire, na im inheritance, as e speak to am.
Moses give to di tribe of di pikin dem of Reuben according to dem families.
Dem border na from Aroer, wey dey for di edge of di valley of Arnon, and di city wey dey for di middle of di valley, and all di plain by Medeba,
Heshbon, and all im cities wey dey for di plain, Dibon, and Bamoth Baal, and Beth Baal Meon,
and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth Shahar for di mount of di valley,
and Beth Peor, and di slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth,

and all di cities of di plain, and all di kingdom of Sihon king of di Amorites, wey rule for Heshbon, wey Moses strike with di chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, di princes of Sihon, wey dey live for di land.
Di pikin dem of Israel kill Balaam di pikin of Beor, di soothsayer, with di sword too, among di rest of dem wey dem kill.
Di border of di pikin dem of Reuben na Jordan, and im border. Dis na di inheritance of di pikin dem of Reuben according to dem families, di cities and di villages of am.
Moses give to di tribe of Gad, to di pikin dem of Gad, according to dem families.
Dem border na Jazer, and all di cities of Gilead, and half of di land of di pikin dem of Ammon, reach Aroer wey dey before Rabbah,
and from Heshbon reach Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim, and from Mahanaim reach di border of Debir,

and for di valley, Beth Haram, and Beth Nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, di rest of di kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and im border, reach di lower end of di sea of Chinnereth for di other side of Jordan for di east.
Dis na di inheritance of di pikin dem of Gad according to dem families, di cities and di villages of am.
Moses give inheritance to di half-tribe of Manasseh, and e dey for di half-tribe of di pikin dem of Manasseh according to dem families.
Dem border na from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all di kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all di towns of Jair, wey dey for Bashan, 60 cities,

and half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, di cities of di kingdom of Og for Bashan. Dem dey for di pikin dem of Machir di pikin of Manasseh, even for half of di pikin dem of Machir according to dem families.
Dis na di inheritances wey Moses share for di plains of Moab, for di other side of Jordan by Jericho, for di east.
But to di tribe of Levi, Moses no give inheritance. Di Lord, di God of Israel, na dem inheritance, as e tell dem.

Dis na di inheritances wey di pikin dem of Israel take for di land of Canaan, wey Eleazar di priest, and Joshua di pikin of Nun, and di heads of di papa houses of di tribes of di pikin dem of Israel, share to dem,
by di lot of dem inheritance, as di Lord command by Moses, for di nine tribes, and for di half-tribe.
Because Moses don give di inheritance of di two tribes and di half-tribe for di other side of Jordan, but to di Levites e no give inheritance among dem.

Because di pikin dem of Joseph na two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and dem no give portion to di Levites for di land, except cities to live inside, with dem suburbs for dem livestock and for dem possessions.
As di Lord command Moses, so di pikin dem of Israel do, and dem divide di land.

Den di pikin dem of Judah come to Joshua for Gilgal, and Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh di Kenizzite talk to am say, “You know di thing wey di Lord speak to Moses di man of God concerning me and concerning you for Kadesh Barnea.
I dey 40 years old when Moses di servant of di Lord send me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out di land, and I bring am word again as e dey for my heart.
But my brothers wey go up with me make di heart of di people melt, but I follow di Lord my God with all my heart.
Moses swear for dat day, talk say, ‘Surely di land wey your foot don step on go be inheritance to you and to your pikin dem forever, because you follow di Lord my God with all your heart.’
Now, look, di Lord don keep me alive, as e talk, dis 45 years, from di time wey di Lord speak dis word to Moses, while Israel waka for di wilderness. And now, look, I don reach 85 years old today.
I still strong today as I dey for di day wey Moses send me. As my strength dey den, na so my strength dey now, for war, and to go out and to come in.

Now give me dis hill country, wey di Lord speak about for dat day, because you hear for dat day say di Anakim dey dere, and big cities wey very strong. Maybe di Lord go dey with me, and I go drive dem out, as di Lord talk.”
Joshua bless am, and e give Hebron to Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh as inheritance.
So Hebron become di inheritance of Caleb di pikin of Jephunneh di Kenizzite till today, because e follow di Lord, di God of Israel, with all im heart.
Now di name of Hebron before na Kiriath Arba. Arba na di greatest man among di Anakim. Di land get rest from war.
